allocation_evidence.reason: The native schedule has no allocator instrumentation and supplies no allocation evidence. A separate allocator feasibility lane may be proposed and must never be folded into native timing or gates.

candidate_source_binding.patch_receipt: external candidate source receipt and reviewed production patch are required before freeze; no fabricated candidate commit is permitted

capture_order: Baseline is captured from current production before candidate source edits; candidate uses the identical harness source plus a separately reviewed production patch.

native.schedule_identity: 8 paired AB/BA cells for each of 3 routes; each cell has one baseline and one candidate child; no allocation-instrumented children

performance_claim: Prospective comparison only; timing eligibility does not adopt the candidate.
process_scope: whole child process metrics are retained as setup-inclusive review flags and never substituted for elapsed_ns
purpose: Source-bound owned-ingress comparison with a generic ReadAt regression control. This descriptor is prospective until the reviewed candidate source/build binding is supplied.
recapture_policy: A failed child, invalid binding, or failed gate fails the complete batch. Selective recapture or rerun to chase a passing result is prohibited.

required_gate_scope.generic_read_at: The harness generic ReadAt control suite executes the full refusal/partial-sink/semantic control set. Its results are shared setup evidence for all route reports.
required_gate_scope.owned_reader: Route report gates cover executed per-route reopen/output/inverse/source/cache/sink checks. The generic-only source-backed refusal helper is not relabeled as route-local evidence.
required_gate_scope.owned_vec: Route report gates cover executed per-route reopen/output/inverse/source/cache/sink checks. The generic-only source-backed refusal helper is not relabeled as route-local evidence.
required_gate_scope.qualification_requirement: Focused owned-route tests must remain independently reviewed and bound before candidate acceptance; this protocol does not fabricate route-local execution for the shared generic control.

required_gates: raw member order and ZIP comment preservation
foreign, signed, no-op, limits, and partial-sink refusal
source immutability and exact inverse publication
timing_scope: harness elapsed_ns: preparation, source-backed open, section query, columns edit, commit, and sequential publication; exact six-phase sum
